```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Load your data (assumes your CSV has 'Samples' as the first column)
  #df <- read.csv("Data/metabolite_clr.csv", check.names = FALSE)
  df <- read.csv("Data/Metabolite.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# Example structure using your headers:
# Columns: Samples, Water3M, Water1H, ..., LAC3M1..5, ..., CLC96H1..5
```


```{r}
# 2. Reshape to long format
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Samples,
    names_to = "Sample_ID",
    values_to = "Peak_Area"
  ) %>%
  # Parse group, time point, and replicate from sample name
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      str_starts(Sample_ID, "Water") ~ "Water",
      str_starts(Sample_ID, "LAC")   ~ "LAC",
      str_starts(Sample_ID, "CLC")   ~ "CLC"
    ),
    # Extract time points: 3M, 1H, 24H, 48H, 96H
    TimePoint = str_extract(Sample_ID, "(3M|1H|24H|48H|96H)")
  )

# 3. Extract the Water background baseline (n = 1 per time point)
water_baseline <- df_long %>%
  filter(Group == "Water") %>%
  select(Samples, TimePoint, Water_Area = Peak_Area)

# 4. Calculate Fold Change at each matching time point
fc_by_timepoint <- df_long %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("LAC", "CLC")) %>%
  group_by(Samples, Group, TimePoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Sample_Area = mean(Peak_Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(water_baseline, by = c("Samples", "TimePoint")) %>%
  mutate(
    Water_Area_Adj = if_else(Water_Area == 0 | is.na(Water_Area), 1, Water_Area),
    Fold_Change = Mean_Sample_Area / Water_Area_Adj
  )

# 5. Filter: Keep if Fold_Change >= 3 in AT LEAST ONE time point (any(Fold_Change >= 3))
metabolite_status <- fc_by_timepoint %>%
  group_by(Samples, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    # TRUE if at least one time point has Fold_Change >= 3
    Keep = any(Fold_Change >= 2.5),
    Max_Fold_Change = max(Fold_Change, na.rm = TRUE),
    Best_TimePoint = TimePoint[which.max(Fold_Change)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View metabolites that PASS the filter (Kept)
passed_metabolites <- metabolite_status %>%
  filter(Keep == TRUE)

# View metabolites that FAIL the filter (Excluded as background)
excluded_metabolites <- metabolite_status %>%
  filter(Keep == FALSE)

print(excluded_metabolites)
```
```{r}
# 1. Pivot sample means to wide format
sample_means_wide <- fc_by_timepoint %>%
  select(Samples, Group, TimePoint, Mean_Sample_Area) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = TimePoint,
    values_from = Mean_Sample_Area,
    names_prefix = "Sample_Mean_"
  )

# 2. Pivot water blank baseline to wide format
water_wide <- water_baseline %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = TimePoint,
    values_from = Water_Area,
    names_prefix = "Water_Area_"
  )

# 3. Pivot Fold Change (SBR) to wide format
sbr_wide <- fc_by_timepoint %>%
  select(Samples, Group, TimePoint, Fold_Change) %>%
  mutate(Fold_Change = round(Fold_Change, 2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = TimePoint,
    values_from = Fold_Change,
    names_prefix = "SBR_"
  )

# 4. Join components together with final filter decisions
supplementary_table <- sample_means_wide %>%
  left_join(water_wide, by = "Samples") %>%
  left_join(sbr_wide, by = c("Samples", "Group")) %>%
  left_join(
    metabolite_status %>%
      mutate(
        Max_Fold_Change = round(Max_Fold_Change, 2),
        Filter_Status = if_else(Keep, "RETAINED", "EXCLUDED"),
        Action = if_else(Keep, "Retained for downstream CLR and network analysis", "Excluded as solvent/background artifact")
      ) %>%
      select(Samples, Group, Max_Fold_Change, Best_TimePoint, Filter_Status, Action),
    by = c("Samples", "Group")
  ) %>%
  # Reorder columns logically: 3M -> 1H -> 24H -> 48H -> 96H
  select(
    Metabolite = Samples,
    Crust_Type = Group,
    # Biological Sample Means (n=5)
    `Sample Mean (3M)`  = Sample_Mean_3M,
    `Sample Mean (1H)`  = Sample_Mean_1H,
    `Sample Mean (24H)` = Sample_Mean_24H,
    `Sample Mean (48H)` = Sample_Mean_48H,
    `Sample Mean (96H)` = Sample_Mean_96H,
    # Water Blank Baseline (n=1)
    `Water Area (3M)`   = Water_Area_3M,
    `Water Area (1H)`   = Water_Area_1H,
    `Water Area (24H)`  = Water_Area_24H,
    `Water Area (48H)`  = Water_Area_48H,
    `Water Area (96H)`  = Water_Area_96H,
    # Signal-to-Blank Ratios
    `SBR (3M)`          = SBR_3M,
    `SBR (1H)`          = SBR_1H,
    `SBR (24H)`         = SBR_24H,
    `SBR (48H)`         = SBR_48H,
    `SBR (96H)`         = SBR_96H,
    # Evaluation Metrics
    `Max SBR`           = Max_Fold_Change,
    `Best Time Point`   = Best_TimePoint,
    `Filter Status`     = Filter_Status,
    `Action / Notes`    = Action
  ) %>%
  arrange(Metabolite, Crust_Type)
```


```{r}
# 7. Export table for Data S1 / Supplementary Information
writexl::write_xlsx(supplementary_table, "Data_S1_Fold.xlsx")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Reshape data
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Samples,
    names_to = "Sample_ID",
    values_to = "Peak_Area"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      str_starts(Sample_ID, "Water") ~ "Water",
      str_starts(Sample_ID, "LAC")   ~ "LAC",
      str_starts(Sample_ID, "CLC")   ~ "CLC"
    ),
    TimePoint = str_extract(Sample_ID, "(3M|1H|24H|48H|96H)")
  )

# 2. Extract water control baseline (mu0)
water_baseline <- df_long %>%
  filter(Group == "Water") %>%
  select(Samples, TimePoint, Water_Area = Peak_Area)

# 3. Perform One-Sample t-Test at each time point for LAC and CLC
ttest_results <- df_long %>%
  filter(Group %in% c("LAC", "CLC")) %>%
  left_join(water_baseline, by = c("Samples", "TimePoint")) %>%
  group_by(Samples, Group, TimePoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Sample = mean(Peak_Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Sample   = sd(Peak_Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    Water_Val   = first(Water_Area),
    Fold_Change = Mean_Sample / if_else(Water_Val == 0 | is.na(Water_Val), 1, Water_Val),
    # One-sample t-test: H1 is Mean_Sample > Water_Val
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(Peak_Area, mu = first(Water_Val), alternative = "greater")$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Multiple-testing adjustment across features and time points
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

# 4. Filter: Retain metabolite if p_adj < 0.05 (and Mean > Water) in AT LEAST ONE time point
metabolite_selection <- ttest_results %>%
  group_by(Samples, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    # Significant enrichment in at least one time point
    Pass_tTest = any(p_adj < 0.05 & Mean_Sample > Water_Val, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_p_adj  = min(p_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_FC     = max(Fold_Change, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Retained features
retained_metabolites <- metabolite_selection %>% filter(Pass_tTest == TRUE)
# Excluded background artifacts
excluded_metabolites <- metabolite_selection %>% filter(Pass_tTest == FALSE)
```
